item.description:
What's new in 0.1.41

  • Better "keep awake during file copies": AwakeMate now watches external and removable drives (USB, SD cards, portable SSDs) separately from your internal disk. Those drives are silent unless you are actually writing to them, so even a slow copy to a slow external drive now holds off sleep - the kind of transfer the previous version could miss.
  • The Status screen now shows a "Copying files" row while a copy is holding your Mac awake, so you can see exactly why it is staying up.
